requirements.description: Open-world 3D, very large, multiple distinct environments (hub + 7 shard worlds)
Comic-book 3D cel-shaded style à la Hi-Fi Rush (ink outlines, flat saturated color, painted materials)
Protagonist: blue LIQUID slime with abilities; reads as fluid
Exceptional VFX for attacks, abilities, activation, walking, everything (comic VFX: speed lines, bursts, auras)
Plasma weapon that gathers plasma then fires; smoke, impacts
Lab phenomenon splits world into shards with different physics laws
Collect missing piece per world via stages/events; combine pieces to uncover cause and attempt restoring the past
Stories, dialogue, side characters; deep mystery with shocking reveals and progressive discoveries
Detailed foliage/grass, many unique models (hundreds), buildings, caves, characters
Editable sources, runnable files, usage docs, verification evidence in an organized package
First-person perspective available (user's original spec; third-person default per D-004)
